subject: Renewal review: usage delta, ROI recap & next steps

From: Sam Patel <sam@seismicaudio.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Maya Trivedi <maya@seismicaudio.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal review: usage delta, ROI recap & next steps

Hi Dylan / Maya,

Quick note ahead of our renewal later this quarter. We've pulled Q2 export and saw a ~22% jump in generation token spend month-over-month tied to an expanded personalization experiment. The attached CSV (seismic-q2-usage.csv) shows the spike by route.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood confirm whether the recent model switch (gpt-large.quant) impacted per-token latency or retry rates?
- We want an ROI snapshot tying the uplift to feature engagement (we have some internal metrics but would appreciate Redwood's view).
- If usage sustains, what are our options for smoothing unit-cost (commit/discounts, burst credits)?

Can you put together a 15–30 minute health sync this week?

Thanks,
Sam Patel
VP Product, Seismic Audio
[sam@seismicaudio.com]

Attachment: seismic-q2-usage.csv (csv, 42 KB)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-21T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal review: usage delta, ROI recap & next steps

Sam — thanks for the export, that helped. Looping in Laura (CS) and Karthik (Solutions) to cover both contract options and perf/infra detail.

Quick read:
- We saw the same token uplift on our side; early signal looks like longer generation lengths for the new personalization prompts (more context + few-shot examples).
- Preliminary perf: no sustained increase in error rate, but median tail latency (95th) increased ~120ms on the gpt-large.quant instances for sequences >1024 tokens. We'll validate with Karthik and ops.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-min call to align on where growth is coming from and agree a short-term smoothing plan (commit + burst credit vs. temporary discount).
2) Redwood provides an ROI deck tying current spend to estimated engagement lift (I attached seismic-ROI-deck-v2.pdf).
3) If helpful, we can prepare a 30-day technical remediation plan to reduce tail latency for long sequences.

Proposed times (PDT): Thu 08/22 10:00 or Fri 08/23 13:00 — which works for you?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Dylan: (415) 555-0132

Attachment: seismic-ROI-deck-v2.pdf (pdf, 1.2 MB)

- Can you confirm which routes saw the highest per-request token growth? (front-end personalization vs. backend batch re-ranking)
- Any SLA impacts observed by your engineering team (timeouts, increased retry logic)?
- If you have a preferred commit horizon (6 vs 12 months), let us know — we can model savings for both.

For the meeting, I can run a short adoption/engagement readout tying the token delta to feature uptake and show a staged commit recommendation. If we move forward with a 12-month commit, we can propose a 10% blended unit discount and a one-time burst credit to cover the transition month.
